Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 94, verse 1:

﴿Did We not expand﴾ for you [O Muhammad] ﴿your breast?﴾ — the interrogative is one of affirmation (istifham taqrir), meaning: We did expand [it] for you, [O Muhammad], ﴿your breast﴾ with prophethood and other things.
﴿Who weighed down﴾ ﴿your back﴾. This is like His saying, ﴿That Allah may forgive you what preceded of your sin﴾.

Commentary of al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 94, verse 4:

﴿And We raised high for you your remembrance﴾ by making you mentioned along with My remembrance in the adhan (call to prayer), the iqamah (second call to prayer), the tashahhud (testimony in prayer), the khutbah (sermon), and other than these.
﴿Indeed, with hardship﴾ [al-'usr], meaning the difficulty, ﴿is ease﴾ [yusran], meaning facility.
﴿Indeed, with hardship comes ease.﴾ The Prophet (ﷺ) endured severe hardship from the disbelievers, and then ease came to him through victory over them.
﴿So when you have finished﴾ from the prayer, ﴿then labour﴾ and exert yourself in supplication.
﴿And to your Lord direct your longing, and supplicate humbly.﴾
